title: Person
description: Information about a specific DOGE-affiliated person

name.description: The name of the person. This is also their primary key

sort_name.description: Usually the last name alone, but could include an initial in case of common names. Primarily used for sorting

slug.description: A unique slug for use in URLs for this person

age.description: What was their age in early 2025 when this all started

category.description: What kind of work they are doing for DOGE

own_page.description: Do they have their own page?

blurb.description: A blurb about the person to appear on their page

reporting_notes.description: A text field for collecting any notes about the reporting on the person

table_note.description: A very short note to display in tables about the person

custom_path.description: A custom path for where the name should link to

govt_exit_date.description: A date when they left DOGE entirely

skill.description: What is their skill/role within DOGE?

tech_links.description: Links to any of the usual Musk/Thiel/Andreesen-linked companies

linkedin.description: A likely LinkedIn url for a person (but remember it could be faked)
